QUESTION:
What was the default value of `retention.threshold_percent` in PaderQueue 2.x?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0347] config | retention.threshold_percent (PaderQueue 2.x) | version 2.x
# `retention.threshold_percent` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `90` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | % |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `retention.threshold_percent` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
threshold_percent = 90
```

---

[d0365] config | retention.threshold_percent | version 4.x
# `retention.threshold_percent`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `95` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | % |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `retention.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
threshold_percent = 95
```

# `snapshotter.threshold_percent` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Usage level in percent at which the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `75` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | % |

## Notes

Changes to `snapshotter.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
threshold_percent = 75
```

response.content: In PaderQueue 2.x, the default value of `retention.threshold_percent` was `90%`.
